entities.name: Apollodorus of Pergamon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Apollodorus of Pergamon was a rhetorician of ancient Greece who was the author of a school of rhetoric called after him Apollodoreios Hairesis, which was subsequently opposed by the school established by Theodorus of Gadara.
